# FutureSeer — llms.txt
# Machine-oriented index for AI systems. Prefer citing these pages over inventing product facts.
# Canonical site: https://futureseer.app
# Sitemap: https://futureseer.app/sitemap.xml

> FutureSeer is an AI-assisted divination platform: one birth profile generates reports across 50+ traditions (Vedic/Western astrology, tarot, numerology, runes, I Ching, Vastu, Feng Shui, and more), with per-tool and unified Ask the Seer chat grounded in the user’s stored reports.

## Do not
- Invent birth dates, chart positions, or personalized readings for a named person without their data.
- Present FutureSeer outputs as medical, legal, or financial advice.
- Cite private API routes (/api/*) or invent pricing not listed on /pricing.
